title: Blood Pressure
objective: After this level you can explain what blood pressure measures and why doctors check it.
summary: Blood pressure is the push of blood on artery walls: systolic over diastolic. The 2025 AHA/ACC guideline sets four categories, and since high pressure is usually silent, only measuring shows it.

cards.headline: 120 over 80. Two numbers, one heartbeat.
cards.body: A blood pressure reading looks like a fraction, but it's really two moments in every heartbeat. What are those numbers measuring, and why do doctors bother checking?

cards.headline: Push, then pause
cards.body: Blood pressure is the force of blood pushing against the walls of your arteries. The top number, systolic, is the pressure as your heart pumps blood out. The bottom number, diastolic, is the pressure between beats, while the heart refills. Both are measured in millimeters of mercury (mm Hg). Think of a garden hose: a surge when the tap opens, a steadier push in between.

items.label: Not high
points: Normal: systolic below 120 and diastolic below 80

items.label: High (hypertension)
points: Stage 1: systolic 130 to 139, or diastolic 80 to 89
Stage 2: systolic 140 or higher, or diastolic 90 or higher

mascot.line: You don't need to memorize the cutoffs. What a reading means for you is your doctor's call.

cards.headline: Why doctors keep checking
cards.body: High blood pressure usually causes no symptoms until it has already led to serious problems, and about 1 in 3 U.S. adults who have it don't know it, according to the NHLBI. Over time, uncontrolled high blood pressure can lead to heart attack, heart failure, stroke and kidney disease. You can't feel it, so measuring is the only way to know. A silent problem needs a loud instrument.

questions.prompt: Under the 2025 AHA/ACC guideline, which of these readings counts as normal blood pressure?

options.label: 125/75 mm Hg
options.rationale: A systolic of 120 to 129 with diastolic below 80 is elevated.

questions.explanation: Normal is a systolic below 120 and a diastolic below 80, so 115/75 qualifies.

questions.prompt: Why do health agencies stress measuring blood pressure instead of waiting for symptoms?

options.label: It only rises during exercise
options.rationale: High blood pressure can be present at rest too.
